body:
## Problem

plugins/adlc-pi/lib/commands.mjs's `/adlc-approve-spec` handler derives `rounds`/`questions` (fields the P1 gate requires as positive integers, per packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs's specApprovalIntegrityErrors) from `priorEntryCount` -- the number of ticket-scoped parallax/premortem manifest entries recorded by the separate `/adlc-spec` prompt-template flow. This is a real, non-empty floor on recorded interrogation artifacts, but not a count of individual questions actually asked and answered within them: a single premortem record could contain one proposed failure cause or ten, and Pi has no structured transcript distinguishing those cases. `unresolved` and `approved_assumptions` are also hardcoded (`0` and `[]`) rather than read from any recorded verdict content.

## Context

This gap is deliberately documented, not fixed, in .adlc/specs/p0-p1-human-interrogation.md's second "Open question" section ("rounds/questions are self-reported counts, not verified content"), added alongside T-01M05MH142KEXEY28HM4SRSDC8. Claude Code's `/adlc-approve-spec` does not have this gap -- it is answered by the same session that ran the interactive `AskUserQuestion`-driven `/adlc-spec` loop, so its self-reported counts reflect that session's actual activity. This ticket is Pi-specific.

Three options were left open: (a) build a structured interrogation transcript -- persisted by parallax/premortem (or the `/adlc-spec` prompt-template flow that drives them) containing the real per-round question list and answers, consumed rather than approximated by `/adlc-approve-spec` -- a cross-package change; (b) restrict Pi's `/adlc-approve-spec` to only harnesses/flows that do conduct a real, instrumented dialog; (c) accept the current artifact-count floor as sufficient given `unresolved: 0` and the file-hash/ticket binding already prevent the more severe failure (spec approved before ANY interrogation artifact exists).

## Acceptance criteria

- A decision is recorded choosing (a), (b), or (c) with reasoning: verify with `adlc ticket show <this-id> --json` showing the recorded decision, or a referencing spec file.
- If (a): parallax and/or premortem record a structured per-round question count in their manifest entries (not just free-text `verdict`), and `plugins/adlc-pi/lib/commands.mjs` derives `rounds`/`questions` from that structure instead of `priorEntryCount`: verify with `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/commands.test.mjs` after adding a test asserting a premortem record containing N structured questions yields `questions: N`, not the entry count.
- If (b): `/adlc-approve-spec` in `plugins/adlc-pi/lib/commands.mjs` refuses (rather than approximates) when only artifact-count evidence is available, with a clear error pointing at the harness that does conduct a real dialog: verify with a new test in `plugins/adlc-pi/test/commands.test.mjs`.
- If (c): the spec's second "Open question" section is updated to state this as the accepted model, with the rationale, rather than an open question: verify with `grep -c 'Open question' .adlc/specs/p0-p1-human-interrogation.md` returning 1 (only the approver-identity section remains open) instead of 2.
title: Pi's spec-approval rounds/questions are an artifact-count floor, not a verified interrogation transcript
